fields.description: Shortlist 1 candidate per N applications, where available
fields.label: Default Shortlisting Ratio (1:N)

fields.description: Users with this role may record an approval on any step (e.g. a signed paper copy). Leave blank to disable overrides.
fields.label: Approval Override Role

fields.description: When unchecked, a person who approved one step of a Green Sheet cannot approve a later step of the same sheet.
fields.label: Allow One Person to Approve Multiple Steps

fields.description: Users with this role may set any Job Opening status without an approved Green Sheet. Leave blank to disable.
fields.label: Job Status Override Role

fields.description: Duties that go beyond read/write on a document type.
fields.label: Duty Roles

fields.description: May verify or reject candidates' onboarding documents.
fields.label: Document Verifier Roles

fields.description: May create and sign a Corrigendum.
fields.label: Corrigendum Signer Roles

fields.description: Limit for resume, SOP, transcripts and certificates. Document Types set their own limit.
fields.label: Max Upload Size (MB)

fields.description: Shown on every application form; the candidate must accept it to submit.
fields.label: Application Declaration
Application Instructions
fields.description: General instructions shown on every application form (the Instructions button). Post-specific instructions are added on each Position / Job Opening.
Roles managed from Pathways > Roles & Permissions. Holding any of these gives access to the Pathways app.
fields.label: Pathways Roles

fields.description: A referee's form link stops working this many days after it is sent. Resending issues a new link.
fields.label: Referee Link Valid For (Days)

fields.description: Referees who have not answered get one reminder this many days after the link was sent. 0 turns reminders off.
fields.label: Remind Referee After (Days)
Calendar for Interview Meetings
fields.description: Interviews scheduled with Google Meet create an event in this Google Calendar, with a Meet link, inviting the candidate (and the panel for final interviews).

fields.label: Offers & Appointment Orders
fields.description: Who reviews and signs appointment orders (workflow steps 26-28).

fields.label: Offer Requires Approved Post-Interview Green Sheet
fields.description: When ticked, an offer can only be created for a candidate named as recommended or waitlisted on an approved Post-Interview Green Sheet.

fields.label: Offer Reviewer Roles
fields.description: May approve a draft appointment order for signature, or return it for changes (Assistant Manager PNC).

fields.label: Offer Signatory Roles
fields.description: May sign appointment orders (the Registrar).

fields.label: Signatory Title
fields.description: Printed under the signature on appointment orders.

fields.label: Saved Registrar Signature
fields.description: Optional. A signatory can sign with this image instead of drawing a signature each time.

fields.label: Interview Rounds
fields.description: Round 1 (HR interaction) assessors, the panellist's signature on the Interview Assessment Form, and the Selection Committee calendar block (workflow steps 13, 15 and 18).

fields.label: HR Assessors per Round 1 Interview
fields.description: The most HR assessors one Round 1 (HR interaction) interview can have.

fields.label: Require Drawn Signature on Assessment Forms
fields.description: Panellists and HR assessors must sign the assessment form on screen before submitting their scores. Scores typed in by the recruitment team from a signed paper form are exempt.

fields.label: Calendar Block Roles
fields.description: Besides the panel, users with these roles get the Selection Committee sitting in their calendar when its date and time are saved.

fields.label: Joining & Onboarding
fields.description: Defaults for a new joiner's first day, used in the onboarding email until the joining is finalised (workflow steps 31 and 34). Which documents a joiner must submit is set per document on the Document Type master (Used In: Onboarding or Both, optionally per track).

fields.label: Default Reporting Location
fields.default: Ground Floor, Training Centre Room No. 004

fields.label: Panel Honorarium
fields.description: Used by "Send thank-you to panel" on the consolidated score sheet (workflow step 33).

fields.label: Honorarium for External Experts Only
fields.description: Internal panellists are still thanked; their honorarium is recorded as Not applicable.
